summary: This informational memo describes how an email client should handle voice and fax messages, including those sent using the Voice Profile for Internet Mail (VPIM). It gives guidance on what a receiving client should expect and do with such messages.

eli5.summary: Sometimes email carries a voice message instead of text. This document explains how an email program should treat these talking messages so they play properly.

questions: how should email clients handle voice messages
